summary: FR-PROXY-016: RelayedBodyStream maps mid-body backend failures (short Content-Length body, malformed chunk, read timeout) to a ProxyException of the kind, logs it once via the app logger, then throws IOException(cause); the proxy never calls res.abort, and a client abort is not logged. TDD check and prickly review were done inline in the foreground (no subagents). Declared limit: the total-timeout watchdog is not installed yet (ProxyExchange.NO_WATCHDOG), so mapping a watchdog close to TOTAL_TIMEOUT is wave 18.

commits.subject: test(proxy): mid-response backend failures abort the client
feat(proxy): log and rethrow backend failures after the response started
